objections.sense: level of the children of the Victors
objections.reason: Follows T034/T143: jina is 'Vincitore'; consistent with the children's field.
Follows T034/T143: jina is 'Vincitore'; same as T110 and children's field.
apramāda is 'vigilanza' in T121; 'Diligenza' is used for vīrya (T102), so the chapter title is inconsistent and misleading.
Variant of T391 'rimpianto'; same word must have the same academic rendering.
'apprensione' means worry in Italian and is also used for ālambana in T286; 'timore' conveys fear of wrongdoing.
Inconsistent with dal ba rendered 'agio' in T221 and T195; 'opportunità' changes the term.
'lama' is ambiguous in a Tibetan Buddhist text (a teacher); 'spada' is clear for children.
'dedicazione' is not the usual term and conflicts with T300; use 'dedica' for dedicating merit.
'noncuranza' means indifference; consistent with T141 'negligenza' for pramāda.
'perversità' suggests moral wickedness; viparyaya means inversion or distorted view.
'sussistenza errata' is unnatural; the Eightfold Path term is based on 'sostentamento'.
